title: CSBC Bihar Police Driver DET Admit Card 2026
organization: Central Selection Board of Constable, Bihar
vacancyDetails: Driver Constable in Bihar Police and Bihar Special Armed Police – 4,361 posts (Advt. No. 02/2025)
qualification: Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent qualification with a valid driving licence as prescribed in the official notification
ageLimit: As prescribed in CSBC Advt. No. 02/2025, with applicable relaxation for reserved categories
applicationFee: As prescribed in CSBC Advt. No. 02/2025
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Driving Efficiency Test (DET) → Document Verification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: DET e-Admit Card, valid photo ID and valid Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) driving licence as applicable

shortDescription: CSBC Bihar Police Driver DET Admit Card 2026 has been released. Candidates selected for the Driving Efficiency Test can download their e-Admit Card from the official CSBC website.
content:
Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC), Bihar has released the Driving Efficiency Test (DET) e-Admit Card for Driver Constable recruitment under Advt. No. 02/2025.

The recruitment is for 4,361 Driver Constable posts in Bihar Police and Bihar Special Armed Police. Candidates shortlisted for the DET should download their e-Admit Card from the official CSBC website and follow the date, venue and instructions mentioned in it.
